clips.title: The story
paras: Near the Tower of Althalaxx, Balthule Shadowstrike watches the northern Darkshore coast. He serves Delgren the Purifier as a forward scout, keeping watch on the dark practitioners in the ancient elven ruins.

West of the Tower of Althalaxx, Balthule Shadowstrike keeps a lonely, dangerous watch. Restless spirits and shadowed ruins mark northern Darkshore, but the tower poses a particular threat. Under Delgren the Purifier’s direction, Balthule watches the dark casters who have entered the ancient Highborne ruins.
